measurementMethod: Actual final DOM image and solution-column rectangles read in a live Archive engine at 1440x1000, deviceScaleFactor 1, mode=sol, no fit=screen/page-fit. Each loaded SVG was SHA-256 hashed. Each parsed SVG was mounted inline at the exact measured rendered image dimensions; computed SVG CSS font size was multiplied by the actual screen CTM scale for every <text> label.
